description: Quantities cited in the paper that are not produced by a released script, and counts computed by the release build from released tables.

second_product_corpus.provenance: recorded in working notes, no generating script
second_product_corpus.note: Total size of the Codex CLI session logs read by s14 on 2026-09-06; file count also in second_product/a3_codex.json (session_files).

grouping_factor_B_directories.provenance: recorded in working notes, no generating script
grouping_factor_B_directories.note: Directory census of the project's scripts tree at the start of the study; the 7 + 13 directory names are the layer_dirs / feature_dirs of the withheld config used by s04.

codified_assets_created_at_window_start.provenance: recorded in working notes, no generating script
codified_assets_created_at_window_start.note: All 17 skill files were created right after the observation window opened, so no period without codified context exists in the corpus.

resumed_pair_duplicates_main_corpus.provenance: share computed by s09 (results/b5_reemission.json: verdict.cross_session_share_of_duplicates_pct); the number of session pairs (1) and the pair identity are recorded in working notes, no generating script
resumed_pair_duplicates_main_corpus.note: All cross-session duplicates come from one resumed session pair (re-emission gap 0 s).

prior_extraction_within_session_duplicat.provenance: count produced by s12 (results/prior_extraction_duplication.json: duplicated_WITHIN_single_session); the breakdown by resource key / tool / resolution is recorded in working notes, no generating script
prior_extraction_within_session_duplicat.note: All 237 within-session duplicates are multi-path shell commands: one tool call yields one record per resolved path.

subagent_rescan_difference.provenance: computed by the release build: set difference of agent transcript file names between data/pilot_subagents_20260904.csv and data/pilot_subagents_20260905.csv (before hashing)

observation_window.provenance: computed by the release build from results/pilot_summary_main.json window_utc
